newsitem.title: FRANCE: French unions call one-day oil strike for Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: French unions call one-day oil strike for Dec 10.

text.p: France's leading trade unions called on oil company employees planning disruption on December 10 to widen their protests to a full one-day oil industry strike.

They urged workers to "prepare to merge the actions already planned into a total strike in all sectors of the oil industry on December 10," the head of the chemicals branch at the Communist-led CGT union, Georges Hervo, told Reuters.
He was reading from a text agreed between France's five main trade unions in a meeting on Wednesday afternoon.
Unions had earlier called for unspecified disruption at Shell France plants and refineries run by Esso France next week to protest about oil industry cost-cutting and plans to reduce jobs.

Unions called separately on Wednesday for a strike at one of two Shell refineries in France on December 9. It was not clear whether this would now be switched to coincide with whatever strikes took place on December 10.
About a quarter of France's oil refinery production has been at a standstill since seven days ago when workers at Elf Aquitaine halted three plants in a dispute over jobs.
